plan.title: Ward 18 Hospital Corridor Coordinated Emergency Mitigation

actions.recommendation: Deploy 2x High-Capacity Mobile Pumps to Ward 18 Low-Point Sump (Station 4B).
actions.reason: Ward 18 primary drain capacity depleted to 28%. Backwater effect detected at Gate 2.
actions.expectedImpact: Reduces water accumulation by 65% in 20 minutes; lowers flood risk score by 22 pts.

actions.recommendation: Activate Green-Wave Traffic Signal Timing on Route B (EVR Periyar Salai) and restrict Gate 1 to emergency transit.
actions.reason: Hospital Road speed dropped to 6 km/h. Bottleneck forming at Trauma Center Gate 1.
actions.expectedImpact: Clears 80% of non-essential traffic away from hospital corridor within 8 minutes.

actions.recommendation: Reroute Ambulance #108-B4 and all incoming trauma units to Route B via EVR Periyar Salai.
actions.reason: Ambulance #108-B4 carrying critical cardiac patient stuck 800m from ER entrance.
actions.expectedImpact: Guarantees direct ER access in 11 minutes (saving 18 minutes of transit time).

actions.recommendation: Issue localized civic alert via SMS & Radio for Ward 18 drivers to bypass Hospital Road.
actions.reason: 38 geotagged reports of knee-deep water on Hospital Road verified within 15 mins.
actions.expectedImpact: Diverts approximately 35% of incoming commuter traffic.
